notes: BMAP on RFCOMM channel 8, confirmed via the [0.1] GET init (which the QC45 answers with '1.1.0' and requires before anything else). The channel probe that picked 8 is off-pin: what is frozen is the wire after the init — the battery [2.2] and current-mode [31.3] GETs, then START [31.3] switches and the device's own readbacks. The QC45 has only Quiet (0, anc) and Aware (1, ambient); its custom slots 2-3 are unconfigured here and were never named. A set is acked by an empty PROCESSING and only the readback that follows moves the line.

steps.note: the socket is up and the [0.1] init has been answered; battery and current-mode queries go out
[2.2] STATUS: 90% (0x5a), the only battery this headset has
nothing is printed until the mode is known
[31.3] PROCESSING: the START is acked, not answered
the ack alone must not move the line
89% now — the level the device reports is the line's
the QC45 has no off; a mode outside available is never sent
